intro.title: 17 Mukhi Rudraksha Mala
intro.descriptionHtml: Explore Rudra Centre's collection of 17 Mukhi Rudraksha Malas, available in a variety of handcrafted designs in premium thread and sterling silver. 17 Mukhi Rudraksha is ruled by Katyayani Devi and governed by Saturn, and is revered for bestowing wealth creation, victory over obstacles, and divine magnetism. It is believed to enhance intuition, intellectual clarity, and help fulfill desires related to relationships, progeny, career growth, and overall prosperity. Our malas are strung head-to-tail as per RRCT, preserving the natural circuit of energy flow. Each bead is individually handpicked and carefully inspected to ensure well-defined Mukhi lines and suitability for energetic healing. We use only premium-quality thread and sterling silver to ensure exceptional durability, strength, and long-lasting wear, offering an authentic mala crafted for both spiritual practice and everyday use.
